specs.label: Settings ▸ El-stat checkbox
specs.note: toggles clean_electro_mode via cmd.set then refreshes; must not error (effect is on the Clean term, not directly visible)

specs.label: Settings ▸ Bumps checkbox
specs.note: toggles sculpt_vdw_vis_mode via cmd.set then refreshes; must not error

specs.label: Settings ▸ Undo Enabled checkbox (opens per-object modal)
specs.note: unchecking 'Undo Enabled' sets suspend_undo and returns the affected objects, which pops the 'Enable Undo for these objects?' modal

specs.label: Undo-objects modal ▸ No
specs.note: the No button dismisses the enable-undo-for-objects modal

specs.label: Undo-objects modal ▸ Yes (enableUndoForObjects)
specs.note: the Yes button runs enableUndoForObjects for the listed objects and closes the modal

specs.label: Settings ▸ Undo button
specs.note: Undo calls cmd.undo; the coordinate ring undo is a no-op in this engine (undo_is_noop) but the button must not error

specs.label: Settings ▸ Redo button
specs.note: Redo calls cmd.redo; the coordinate ring undo is a no-op in this engine (undo_is_noop) but the button must not error

specs.label: Keyboard ▸ Ctrl+Z (undo)
specs.note: the panel's onKeyDown maps Ctrl+Z (undo) to cmd.undo/redo; fired on a builder descendant so it reaches the handler. No-op ring undo, must not error

specs.label: Keyboard ▸ Ctrl+Shift+Z (redo)
specs.note: the panel's onKeyDown maps Ctrl+Shift+Z (redo) to cmd.undo/redo; fired on a builder descendant so it reaches the handler. No-op ring undo, must not error

specs.label: Keyboard ▸ Ctrl+Y (redo)
specs.note: the panel's onKeyDown maps Ctrl+Y (redo) to cmd.undo/redo; fired on a builder descendant so it reaches the handler. No-op ring undo, must not error

specs.label: Pick strip ▸ unpick
specs.note: the unpick button calls cmd.unpick and refreshes; must not error (nothing picked -> clears any pk selections)

specs.label: Wizard strip ▸ dismiss
specs.note: with a wizard armed (via Fix H), the dismiss button disarms it and the wizard strip disappears

specs.label: Wizard strip ▸ Cancel panel button
specs.note: the synthesized wizard's Cancel panel row (builder_wizard_click) disarms the pending tool

specs.label: Viewport pick ▸ atom (multi) routed to builder_pick
specs.note: in editing mode a viewport atom click routes through registerPickRoute to cmd.builder_pick(object,index+1,null,'multi'); needs GL-backed picking, absent in local mode

specs.label: Viewport pick ▸ bond routed to builder_pick
specs.note: when a bond wizard (Valence/Unbond) is armed, a stick/line click resolves both ends and routes as mode 'bond'; needs GL-backed picking, absent in local mode

specs.label: Clear confirm ▸ Yes (delete everything)
specs.note: the Yes button runs builder_action('clear') = cmd.delete('all'); the footer then reports 0 object(s) and the viewport empties. RUN LAST — destroys the preloaded object
